title: NSA TREAT Men in Black unit

tellings.quote: it's the supposed uh men in black uh unit out of the NSA called the tactical reconnaissance engineering assessment search team which was created by Stubbleine

plain: The NSA had a 'Men in Black' unit, the kind of secret team said to visit UFO witnesses and silence them, called the Tactical Reconnaissance Engineering Assessment Search Team, and it was created by a retired general named Albert Stubblebine. That is what an online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels. He calls it 'the supposed' unit and passes on what others told him, with archived emails he calls the DPI archive among his sources. If true, it would mean an American intelligence agency kept a team to do the work the folklore gives to the men in black.
